title: Bilateral Bailey lattice with independently varying parameters
author: Jehanne Dousse; Frédéric Jouhet; Isaac Konan
difficulty_reason: The independently varying parameter lattice requires deriving a symmetric-polynomial/q-binomial recurrence and proving coefficient cancellation in two layers before the rank induction closes. Repeated application of the one-parameter Bailey lemma alone does not establish the explicit finite alpha transform; adjacent specialized identities are grouped with this construction rather than counted separately.
